description: This file defines a Java class MultivaluedMapContext that manages a map with multiple values per key, extending functionality from MapContext, specifically designed to handle multi-valued mappings in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MultivaluedMapContext
classes.description: A context map that allows multiple values to be associated with a single key, extending MapContext to support multi-valued entries.

methods.name: MultivaluedMapContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the multi-valued map context.

methods.name: putSingle
methods.description: Associates a single value with a key, replacing any existing values.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a value to the list of values associated with a key, preserving existing values.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Retrieves the first value associated with a key, or null if none exists.
